Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

The Client Success Director is a key leadership role with responsibility for both managing a portfolio of strategic client accounts and leading a team that delivers high-quality post-sale service and operational support. In this position, you will act as a play maker who balances direct client management with active team leadership.

You are accountable for the overall client experience. This includes working closely with senior client stakeholders to understand their business needs and ensure they receive ongoing value from our solutions. The role involves driving product adoption, supporting client growth and serving as the main advocate for client interests across different functions and regions.

You will also lead your team by setting clear direction and providing continuous support. You will foster a collaborative and high-performance culture and encourage professional growth. You will ensure that your team’s work aligns with Client Success strategies and help them navigate complex challenges in support of our clients.

This role provides an opportunity to contribute to our Client Success transformation. You will work with cross-functional partners to deliver strong outcomes for clients and support the ongoing development of your team. The Director Client Success reports to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations and is based in Frankfurt.

**Responsibilities include:**

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Client Success team. Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented culture
- Align your team’s work with the overall Client Success strategy. Inspire team members to embrace change, adopt best practices, and continuously grow their skills and expertise
- Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration within your team and across the wider Client Success organization
- Oversee your team’s client portfolios to ensure consistent, high-quality post-sale service and operational support
- Directly manage a portfolio of strategic client accounts. Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by acting as a proactive advisor and advocate
- Serve as the primary point of contact for your own clients, understanding their business strategies, operational goals, and priorities. Ensure their needs are met and that they realize ongoing value from Visa solutions
- Develop, execute, and monitor Client Success Plans for your own clients, in alignment with the Account Team. Track key outcomes including product adoption, performance, and satisfaction
- Oversee and support the implementation of new Visa products for both your own clients and those managed by your team. Coordinate with key client and Visa stakeholders to expedite readiness activities, maximize adoption, and deliver value—often across multiple geographies
- Guide your team in understanding client systems landscapes, integration points, and critical opportunities and challenges. Support them in identifying and addressing client needs that align with business growth
- Drive and deliver initiatives that improve client adoption of Visa products and promote the use of self-service tools. Monitor and report on health metrics for your own clients and those managed by your team.
- Serve as a thought leader on market trends, Visa solutions, and new technologies. Help both your team and your clients stay informed and ahead of industry developments.
- Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Client Services and other internal teams. Lead efforts to resolve complex client issues and optimize performance through effective collaboration.
- Share knowledge and insights regularly with colleagues across Client Success, Sales, Product, and other functions both for your own clients and more broadly within the market or region.
- Oversee and contribute to the development and delivery of client education and training, including webinars and communications on new Visa rules and business enhancements.
- Lead or participate in operational reviews with clients and internal stakeholders, including at an international level for global clients.
- Act as the escalation point for major issues and incidents for your own clients and those managed by your team. Provide guidance and support during crisis response and ensure effective resolution.
- Champion operational excellence by encouraging your team to support cross-functional initiatives and seek opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity.
- Proactively monitor client health and satisfaction for your own portfolio and your team’s. Identify opportunities to optimize performance and coordinate with specialist teams as needed.
- Lead key strategic initiatives that support the global Client Success transformation. Serve as a role model for change and continuous improvement within your team and for your own clients.
- Deliver operational resilience support by coordinating client communications and response during crisis events, ensuring client needs are addressed and escalations are managed according to established plans.

**Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**

**Qualifications**

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to extract and synthesize data into actionable business solutions and provide sound analysis
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and processes in clear business language tailored to the audience
- Proven experience coaching or mentoring team members for skill and career development, either informally or in a formal leadership role
- Prior people management experience required, ideally within a matrixed and multi-location environment
- Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines
- Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and applications, and how they can create value for Visa and its clients
- Experience representing technical and business issues and solutions to influence various audiences, including senior executives, in support of strategic business plans
- In-depth knowledge of the payments industry, including trends, threats, competitors, and regulatory environments relevant to the client segment and region/market
- Ability to lead cross-functional teams through high-impact, complex, or ambiguous business issues without precedent
- Certifications or qualifications in Client/Customer Success, project management, or related disciplines are preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills **in German and English.** Able to convey complex topics in clear, simple terms tailored to the client’s specific use cases.
- Advanced proficiency in the following areas:
    - Building client relationships: establishing credibility and trust; partnering with clients to grow their business
    - Customer centricity: listening to and prioritizing client needs to drive value realization and trusted partnerships
    - Success planning: creating measurable action plans to help clients achieve business goals and maximize value from products and solutions
    - Client engagement: communicating clearly and effectively with clients at all levels
    - Proactiveness: anticipating needs and taking initiative
    - Critical thinking: owning and solving complex problems with creative solutions

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

descriptionHtml:

you have the ability to multitask

you are an excellent communicator with good coordination and Cultural awareness skills

having the service and support towards the customer is part of your DNA

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this. If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

With our global functional organisation spanning across eleven different sites and locations worldwide, you will be part of a truly global family. Change is the only constant at Satair. title: Technical Account Manager (m/w/d) – KI-Voice-Agents | Remote oder Kempten
descriptionHtml:
Als **Technical Account Manager (m/w/d)** bei Famulor bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Produkt- und Engineering-Team. Du hilfst Unternehmen dabei, das volle Potenzial unserer KI-Telefonieplattform auszuschöpfen — von der ersten Implementierung über die Integration in CRM-, Ticketing- und Kalendersysteme bis hin zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Voice-Agents im laufenden Betrieb.

Du verstehst sowohl die technischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden als auch die Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform — und übersetzt zwischen beiden Welten. Damit sorgst du nicht nur für reibungslose Go-Lives, sondern auch für langfristigen Kundenerfolg und echte Begeisterung für unser Produkt.

**Deine Aufgaben**

Technische Beratung und Onboarding unserer B2B-Kunden — von Mittelstand bis Enterprise. Implementierung und Konfiguration von KI-Voice-Agents inkl. System-Prompts, Wissensdatenbanken und Integrationen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Engineering-Team: Du sammelst technische Anforderungen, priorisierst Feature-Requests und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für komplexe Use-Cases. Begleitung der Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg — Troubleshooting, Performance-Reviews, Use-Case-Erweiterung. Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation, Tutorials und Best-Practice-Guides.

**Dein Profil**

Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport, Customer Success oder Technical Account Management — idealerweise im SaaS-, KI- oder Telekommunikationsumfeld. Solides Verständnis von APIs, Webhooks und SIP-Telefonie; Erfahrung mit Voice-/AI-Plattformen ist ein klares Plus. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch — schriftlich wie mündlich. Lösungsorientierte Denkweise, Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude daran, Dinge ans Laufen zu bringen. Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (HubSpot, Pipedrive o. ä.) und strukturierter technischer Dokumentation. Begeisterung für KI, Automatisierung und die Zukunft der Sprachkommunikation.

**Wir bieten Dir**

Attraktives Gehalt mit **Equity-Beteiligung** — du wirst Teil des Erfolgs, den du mit aufbaust. Zusätzliches Provisionsmodell für erfolgreiche Kundenbetreuung und Account-Wachstum. Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Modernes Büro in Kempten (Allgäu) oder Remote aus ganz Deutschland. Arbeiten an der Spitze der KI-Technologie — mit einem Produkt, das echten Impact bei unseren Kunden hat. Flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikationswege und „Duz-Kultur". Weiterbildungsbudget, Konferenzbesuche und gezielte Förderung deiner persönlichen Entwicklung. Bei Office-Tagen in Kempten: kostenlose Getränke, Obstkörbe und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld.

**Quereinstieg möglich:** Du kommst aus Vertrieb, Account Management oder Customer Success, aber nicht aus der Logistik? Kein Problem. Das Logistik-Know-how bringen wir dir bei. Wichtiger sind uns Kundenverständnis, Abschlussstärke und ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen.

### Über uns

Die eLogix GmbH ist Fulfillment- und Logistikdienstleister für Onlinehändler. Für D2C-Marken und Amazon-Seller übernehmen wir die komplette Kette: Import, Transport, Lagerung, Kommissionierung und Versand. Unsere Software entwickeln wir im eigenen Haus. Deshalb sehen unsere Kunden ihre Zahlen in Echtzeit im Dashboard. Unser Anspruch: **Logistik, die digital denkt.** Wir sind aus dem Onlinehandel selbst entstanden und wissen, was Seller brauchen. Wir wachsen schnell, und bei uns erwarten dich kurze Wege, eine echte Du-Kultur und ein direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

### Deine Aufgaben

**Neukundengewinnung (Sales)**

- Du gewinnst neue Brands, von D2C-Start-ups über Amazon-Seller bis zu etablierten Marken
- Du führst Erstgespräche, analysierst Bedarfe und erarbeitest passende Lösungen
- Du kalkulierst und verhandelst Angebote auf Basis unserer offenen Preislogik
- Du baust dein Netzwerk in der E-Commerce-Szene auf, etwa auf Messen, Events und LinkedIn

**Kundenbetreuung (Account Management)**

- Du betreust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen und baust sie aus
- Du begleitest das Onboarding gemeinsam mit Operations und Tech, von der Anbindung bis zur ersten Sendung
- Du führst Quartalsgespräche mit echten Zahlen aus dem Dashboard: Kosten je Sendung, Lieferperformance, Retourenquote
- Du erkennst Potenziale für Zusatzleistungen wie Import, Transportlogistik oder Cross-Border-Versand
- Du trägst Kundenwünsche ins Produkt, denn unsere Software entsteht im Haus

### Dein Profil

- Du hast Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Account Management oder Business Development, gerne in E-Commerce, Logistik oder SaaS
- Du gewinnst gerne neue Kunden und bringst Gespräche zum Abschluss
- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen wie Margen, Tarifen und Kosten je Sendung
- Du trittst souverän auf, bei Gründerinnen und Gründern genauso wie im Konzern
- Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch
- Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast den Anspruch, Dinge wirklich zu lösen
- Du hast Lust, mit einem wachsenden Standort zu wachsen

### Wir bieten

- Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnell wachsenden Logistikunternehmen
- Ein Produkt, hinter dem du stehen kannst: transparente Preise, echte Daten, eigene Software
- Hybrides Arbeiten: Präsenz im Büro in Osnabrück, Kundentermine in unserem Lager in Georgsmarienhütte und teilweise remote
- Direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege
- Echten Einfluss auf Produkt, Preisgestaltung und Prozesse
- Ein Team mit Du-Kultur und flachen Hierarchien

### Gehalt & Einarbeitung

- **Vergütung:** **3.600 € brutto/Monat Fixum** plus **erfolgsabhängige Provision**
- **Einarbeitung:** Du lernst unsere Operations im Lager kennen, steigst in Software und Preislogik ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt erste Accounts und Leads. Die Geschäftsführung begleitet dich dabei.

### Deine Perspektive bei uns

Wir haben große Ziele, und unser Vertrieb wächst mit. Du bist einer der ersten in diesem Bereich und baust ihn aktiv mit auf. Wer Kunden erfolgreich gewinnt und entwickelt, kann bei uns schnell mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, zum Beispiel als Teamleitung Sales & Account Management oder Head of Sales. Dein Einfluss auf Produkt, Preisstrategie und Wachstum wächst mit dir.

title: Renewal Manager SaaS (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
**Renewal Manager SaaS (m/w/d) / Customer Contract Manager SaaS (m/w/d)** gesucht!

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes **Softwareunternehmen**, das innovative Lösungen für Technische Dokumentation, After-Sales und Service entwickelt. Mit einem breiten Portfolio aus modernen Cloud- und bewährten On-Premises-Lösungen begleitet das Unternehmen zahlreiche Kunden bei der industriellen Digitalisierung. Im Zuge der strategischen Weiterentwicklung und der zunehmenden Umstellung auf SaaS- und Subscription-Modelle wird das Renewal Management gezielt ausgebaut.

Zur Verstärkung des Bereichs **Sales Development** suchen wir daher **ab sofort** einen **Renewal Manager SaaS (m/w/d)**, der/die das Vertrags- und Verlängerungsmanagement eigenständig weiterentwickelt und effiziente Prozesse etabliert.

Die Position ist grundsätzlich **deutschlandweit remote** möglich. Für das Onboarding, gemeinsame Workshops und den persönlichen Austausch sind gelegentlich planbare Treffen am Standort des HQ in **Nürnberg** vorgesehen.

### Aufgaben:

- Als *Renewal Manager SaaS (m/w/d)* etablierst Du den Bereich Customer Contract & Process Management und entwickelst ein strukturiertes, skalierbares Renewal Management für das gesamte Softwareportfolio
- Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe rund um Vertragsverlängerungen und Subscription Management, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und definierst neue, effiziente Prozesse
- Du verantwortest die strukturierte Betreuung bestehender Verträge und Subscription-Laufzeiten, von der rechtzeitigen Vorbereitung bis zur erfolgreichen Verlängerung
- Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Customer Success Management, Sales Management, Account Management und weiteren internen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und abgestimmte Abläufe
- Du identifizierst gefährdete bzw. kritische Vertragsverlängerungen (At-Risk-Renewals) und bindest bei Bedarf das Sales- bzw. Account Management ein
- Du koordinierst relevante kaufmännische Prozesse rund um bestehende Kundenverträge, Subscription-Anpassungen und die zugehörige Auftragsabwicklung
- Du nutzt und entwickelst die bestehende Systemlandschaft weiter, insbesondere HubSpot und Microsoft Navision, und schaffst eine verlässliche Daten- und Prozessgrundlage
- Du etablierst geeignete Auswertungen, Reportings und Abstimmungsformate, um Vertragslaufzeiten, Verlängerungen und die Entwicklung des Bereichs transparent zu steuern

### Qualifikationen:

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Customer Success Management, Renewal Management, Subscription Management, Customer Contract Management oder einem vergleichbaren kaufmännischen bzw. vertriebsnahen Umfeld
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im SaaS- und Softwareumfeld sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Subscription-Modelle und mehrjährige Lizenzverträge wünschenswert
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im eigenständigen Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, idealerweise in einem neu geschaffenen oder noch wenig strukturierten Verantwortungsbereich
- Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Customer Success, Sales, Account Management und Order Management und weißt, wie die jeweiligen Bereiche effizient zusammenarbeiten müssen
- Erfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen und neue Prozesse überzeugend zu etablieren
- Eine strukturierte, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, Themen proaktiv voranzutreiben
- Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- und ERP-Systemen; Kenntnisse in HubSpot und Microsoft Navision sind von Vorteil
- Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit und fühlst Dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, in dem nicht jeder Prozess bereits vorgegeben ist
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab

### Benefits:

- Eine gestaltungsprägende Schlüsselrolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung und der Möglichkeit, einen neuen Unternehmensbereich von Grund auf aufzubauen
- Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland möglich
- Ein spannendes SaaS-Transformationsumfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive und großem Entwicklungspotenzial
- Eine Du-Kultur auf Augenhöhe über alle Ebenen hinweg
- Eine klare Unternehmensstrategie, die gemeinsam verfolgt und aktiv weiterentwickelt wird
- Ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld, in dem eigene Ideen willkommen sind und Veränderungen aktiv gestaltet werden können
- Weiterbildungsbudgets für jeden Bereich sowie unternehmensweite Angebote, beispielsweise zu KI, Cloud und Englisch
- Regelmäßige Events und gemeinsame Aktivitäten
- Attraktive Benefits wie Bike-Leasing, Firmenfitness und weitere Zuschüsse

Du möchtest nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern einen neuen Verantwortungsbereich von Grund auf aufbauen? Du hast Erfahrung mit **SaaS-** und **Subscription-Modellen** und weißt, worauf es bei einem professionellen **Renewal Management** ankommt? Dann bietet Dir diese Position die Möglichkeit, Deine Ideen einzubringen und nachhaltige Strukturen zu schaffen. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

title: Werkstudent // Working Student Human Resources (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
**Kelvion**  

Bei Kelvion ist es unsere Mission, den industriellen Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit fördern. Von der Optimierung von Rechenzentren und der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion bis hin zur Revolutionierung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere entscheidenden thermischen Lösungen stärken Branchen auf der ganzen Welt. Vereint als „One Kelvion“ liefert unser globales Team innovative Lösungen, die den Erfolg unserer Kunden voranbringen und eine nachhaltige Zukunft unterstützen.

  
Kelvion – Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft.

 **Aufgaben**  
* Du unterstützt uns tatkräftig im operativen HR-Tagesgeschäft durch die Übernahme von administrativen Aufgaben, wie z.B. bei der Bearbeitung von arbeitsvertraglichen Dokumenten oder dem Erstellen von Arbeitszeugnissen
* Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Pflege unseres Zeitwirtschaftssystems
* Du wirkst bei der Digitalisierung unserer Personalakten mit
* Du bist im Rahmen unseres Recruitings in die Erstellung von Stellenanzeigen und die Terminierung von Gesprächen eingebunden
* Du bist aktiv an HR-Projekten beteiligt und unterstützt so die Optimierung unserer bestehenden Prozesse

 **Qualifikationen**  
* Student*in eines betriebswirtschaftlichen oder ähnlichen Studiengangs, idealerweise mit dem Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement
* Es wäre toll, wenn Du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich HR sammeln konntest
* Ein sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office ist für Dich selbstverständlich
* Es macht Dir Spaß, im Team zu arbeiten und Du bringst Organisationstalent und Eigeninitiative mit
* Du besitzt sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

 **Wir bieten**  

Wir bei Kelvion leben von der Zusammenarbeit, begrüßen die Gedankenvielfalt und schätzen jede Stimme. Innerhalb von Kelvion kommt die Kreativität zum Vorschein, weil den Menschen zugehört wird, ihre Beiträge anerkannt und ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen werden. Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft, indem wir unsere globalen Teams dazu bringen, als „**One Kelvion** “ zu handeln.

 **Kelvion**  

At Kelvion, our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.  

Kelvion – Together, We Shape the Future

 **Tasks**  
* You actively support us in operational HR day-to-day tasks by taking on administrative responsibilities, such as processing employment contract documents or creating employment references.
* You will be involved in maintaining our time management system.
* You will contribute to the digitisation of our personnel files.
* As part of our recruiting efforts, you will assist in creating job postings and scheduling interviews.
* You will actively participate in HR projects, helping to optimise our existing processes.

 **Qualifications**  
* Student of a business administration or similar degree program, ideally with a focus on HR management
* It would be great if you have already gained some experience in HR
* A confident handling of Microsoft Office is a matter of course for you
* You enjoy working in a team and have a talent for organisation and initiative
* You have a very good command of German and English

 **We offer**  

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

title: Spezialist Bankberatung Remote (d/m/w), Regionales Beratungscenter Schkeuditz
descriptionHtml:
**Über uns**
Die Postbank Filialvertrieb AG berät bundesweit die 12,5 Millionen Kund\*innen der Postbank rund um Finanzdienstleistungen und Non-Banking-Produkte, z. B. Post-Services. Dabei legen wir besonders viel Wert auf Beratung und kollegialen Austausch auf Augenhöhe.
Als #diepasstbank haben wir für alle das Passende. Deswegen bringen wir unsere Jobs mit den passenden Talenten zusammen. Menschen, die durch ihr Können, Engagement und durch ihren Teamgeist die Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten.

**Breit gefächert: Ihre Aufgaben**
Als Kundenberater (d/m/w) übernehmen Sie eigenständig die bedarfsorientierte Beratung unserer breit gefächerten Finanzprodukte

Dabei bauen Sie nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen durch persönliche Gespräche und telefonische Kontaktaufnahme auf.

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für die Betreuung der Kund\*innen in Ihrer Filiale.

Mit Ihrem Filialteam arbeiten Sie eng und vertrauensvoll zusammen.

Sie organisieren Ihren Arbeitstag selbständig und sind für Ihre Kund\*innen ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner rund um das Thema Finanzen.

**Überzeugend: Ihr Profil**
Vertriebstalent mit Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft

Erfolgreiche kaufmännische Ausbildung – idealerweise zum Bankkaufmann / zur Bankkauffrau – oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, am besten in der Kundenberatung oder im Vertrieb

Quereinsteiger\*innen mit Spaß am Umgang mit Menschen sind bei uns willkommen

Hohe Servicekompetenz und Belastbarkeit im Arbeitsalltag sowie Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber sich schnell verändernden Rahmenbedingungen

Hohes Interesse an Finanzthemen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

**Das passt: Ihre Vorteile**
Auf Sie wartet ein sicherer, unbefristeter und verantwortungsvoller Job in einem motivierten/ dynamischen und hilfsbereiten Team.

Sie profitieren von einem guten Gehalt, Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld sowie einer attraktiven erfolgsabhängigen Vergütung.

Unser Tarifvertrag bietet Ihnen eine 38,5 Stunden Woche für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

Eine Stellenbesetzung in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich.

Als Postbank Filialvertrieb AG sind wir durch die berufundfamilie gGmbH für unsere familienbewusste Personalpolitik ausgezeichnet.

Wir bieten klare Karrierewege und vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten - zum Beispiel als Spezialist (d/m/w) oder Führungskraft. Dabei zählt für uns allein Ihr Können – und nicht ein akademischer Titel.

**Was wir Ihnen bieten**
**Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all Ihre beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.**

**Emotional ausgeglichen**

Eine positive Haltung hilft uns, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung mentaler Gesundheit.
Körperlich fitMit Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung Ihrer persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft Ihnen die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie umfangreichen Check-up Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.

**Sozial vernetzt**

Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet uns neue Perspektiven, bringt uns beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt unser Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, das FitnessCenter Job, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (bspw. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie sowie von Programmen zur Förderung von Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.

**Finanziell abgesichert**

Die Bank sichert Sie nicht nur während Ihrer aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt Ihre Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeiter\*innen, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket und nutzen Sie exklusive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und individuelle Beratung durch die Mitarbeiterbank.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren, gehen Sie bitte bei konkreten Fragen auf Ihre Recruiter / Ihre Recruiterin zu.

**Passt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Sie und Ihre Bewerbung!**

www.postbank.de/karriere

Gleichberechtigung ist uns sehr wichtig – um aber die Lesbarkeit unserer Texte nicht einzuschränken, verwenden wir nicht durchweg genderneutrale Formen bei Personenbezeichnungen. Diese sind geschlechtsneutral zu verstehen.

**Weitere Informationen**

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten. Deutsche Bank AG · Arben Ajrulahi, +49 1516 7969097 · Deutsche Bank Human Resources

Biopharma is one of the fastest-growing businesses within the Fresenius Group. We develop, manufacture and commercialize biosimilars that make advanced therapies accessible to more patients. With a strong pipeline and a steady pace of product launches, we combine the agility and ambition of a start-up with the scale of a global healthcare company.

As Director Global HRBP Biopharma, you will help ensure our organization, leadership and talent capabilities keep pace with business growth. - Broad HR expertise across disciplines such as organizational design, talent management and reward, combined with the ability to bring structure, set priorities and drive execution

title: PhD in prevention research (m/f/d/x)
employer: BIPS Institut f. Epidemiologie u.Präventionsforschg GmbH
descriptionHtml:
Job announcement

The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH invites applications for several positions (depending upon funding) to be filled as

PhD in prevention research (m/f/d/x)

Salary scale 13 TV-L (70% position).

Starting from January 1, 2027 or later for the duration of 3 years (extension possible).

In the coming years, the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS will expand its research into the prevention of chronic, non-communicable diseases across the life course. The focus is on factors beyond individual diseases, such as lifestyle and environment, digital media, biological and social factors, as well as early detection. Existing large cohort studies based on primary data based will be used (e.g., IDEFICS/I.Family cohort study, NAKO Health Study), a birth cohort will be established and secondary data (health claims data) will be analyzed. Further, implementation and interventional research will be conducted to develop and evaluate innovative strategies for targeted prevention. The research is cross-departmental and involves all scientific departments of BIPS.

In this context, we are looking for several PhD students with interest in at least one of the following areas:

• Epidemiology with a focus on primary data

• Epidemiological research based on health claims data

• Implementation science

• Health decision science

Tasks:

• Coordinate and participate in research projects

• Data analysis and interpretation of results

• Publish and present research results

• Support reporting of results

Requirements:

• Master’s degree (or equivalent including ‘Staatsexamen’) in one of the areas mentioned above or related disciplines

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research

• Initiative, motivation, commitment, and scientific curiosity

What we offer:

The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS offers exciting research topics, a stimulating international environment, a good infrastructure, close ties to the University of Bremen and an engaged, supportive and cooperative team. Postdocs are encouraged to strive for scientific independence and to establish their own research focus. BIPS holds the audit ‘berufundfamilie’ (work and family) certificate and actively promotes the compatibility of career and individual lifestyle through flexible working hours, mobile working options, and continuous professional development. We also offer additional support for international scholars to relocate to Germany through the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance.

Among equally qualified applicants, preference will be given to severely disabled candidates.

Enquiries to: Dr. Wiebke Schäfer, phone: +49 421 218 56 887

Additional information can be found on our homepage: https://www.leibniz-bips.de/en.

Please send your application in English or German including a cover letter, CV and certificates quoting the reference number A26-33 and mention at least of one of the topics above by November 27, 2026 by e-mail as a single PDF file to:

bewerbung@leibniz-bips.de

Please note that applications which do not comply with the required format (1 PDF document) cannot be considered.

For information on salaries, please refer to the TV-L salary calculator for 2026; the position is classified under pay grade E13 of the TV-L. Salary calculator: https://oeffentlicher-dienst.info/c/t/rechner/tv-l/allg?id=tv-l-2026

title: Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV
descriptionHtml:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

# Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV

### Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.01.2027 | ID: FSMA045/2026 | Deadline: 08.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Photon-Science Detector Group designs and builds innovative and state-of-the-art X-ray cameras for us in a variety of scientific experiments, in Hamburg and world wide. We are developing new high-speed cameras for an upcoming major upgrade to our X-ray facilities, PETRA IV, and improved software is required for camera control, data handling, and interfacing to users and the facility's systems. We are looking for a software developer to work on these tasks together with our experts in detector engineering and scientific computing.

With the PETRA IV project, DESY is launching one of the most ambitious and innovative large-scale research projects worldwide. PETRA IV, the most brilliant synchrotron radiation source of the next generation, will be the ultimate 4D X-ray microscope, setting new standards in precision and performance. To implement the project, we are looking for motivated employees who want to get involved in a complex project with international appeal. More information about PETRA IV: [PETRA IV](https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/696)

## About your role:

- Developing software for controlling and configuring a large camera system consisting of multiple units
- Developing a system for receiving detector data at high speed on a set of data acquisition PCs, in collaboration with experts in hardware acceleration
- Developing the interfaces between the X‑ray camera and the facility's control and scientific computing systems

## About you:

- Master's degree in software engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience with embedded and/or systems programming
- Experience with both Python and a lower-level language (preferably C++)
- Good standard of English
- Good team player, and the ability to work effectively with experts in other fields (firmware developers and detector engineers)
- Experience with high performance computing
- Experience with high-speed networking

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. title: PhD Position – Linking Above-Ground Plant Function to Root Dyn...
descriptionHtml:
# PhD Position – Linking Above-Ground Plant Function to Root Dynamics

Plant roots are essential for water and nutrient acquisition and play a key role in how crops respond to environmental stress. Yet, because roots are hidden in the soil, their development and activity remain difficult to observe – particularly under field conditions.

Advances in plant phenotyping, on the other hand, allow us to characterize above- and belowground plant structure and function with increasing temporal resolution. Physiological measurements provide information about photosynthetic carbon assimilation, while sensor-based phenotyping captures dynamic changes in plant growth and stress responses.

To what extent can available above-ground traits be related to root structure and function?

At the Institute of Bio- and Geosciences – Plant Sciences (IBG-2) at Forschungszentrum Jülich, we are looking for a doctoral researcher to address this question within the PhenoRob – Robotics and Phenotyping for Sustainable Crop Production – research environment.

## Your Job

The aim of your PhD project is to relate root dynamics to above-ground physiological and phenotypical measures and traits.

You will investigate how photosynthesis, carbon allocation, shoot development and root growth are connected over time and how these relationships change in response to environmental conditions. To achieve this, you will combine experiments done under controlled conditions with field experiments.

Complementary experiments will provide direct and non-invasive information about shoot and root structure and function. Using advanced imaging approaches such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Positron Emission Tomography (PET), you will follow root development and physiological processes over space and time. Together with measurements of photosynthetic performance, these experiments will help reveal how carbon assimilation and allocation are related to source-sink dynamics and subsequent root and shoot growth.

By combining these complementary datasets, you will investigate whether measurable changes above ground can serve as indicators – and ultimately predictors – of dynamic processes in the hidden root system.

Your tasks will include:

- Design and conduct plant experiments under controlled and field conditions
- Quantify temporal changes in plant structure and function using non-invasive approaches
- Investigate relationships between photosynthetic carbon assimilation, carbon allocation, and subsequent root and shoot growth
- Develop quantitative approaches to relate root development and stress responses to above-ground measurements
- Contribute experimental data to the parameterisation and validation of functional-structural plant models
- Present your results at international conferences and publish them in peer-reviewed scientific journals

The project will be highly collaborative and will connect expertise in plant physiology, root biology, phenotyping, sensing, imaging, data analysis and plant modelling within IBG-2 and the interdisciplinary PhenoRob research environment.

## Your Profile

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who combines scientific curiosity with an interest in experimental and quantitative plant science.

- Excellent Master's degree in plant sciences, biology, agricultural sciences, crop science, environmental sciences, bioengineering or a related discipline
- Motivation to combine controlled experiments with field-based plant research
- Interest in linking physiological processes with imaging and sensor-derived plant traits
- Experience in quantitative data analysis and statistics
- Experience with R, Python or comparable tools is advantageous
- Very good command of written and spoken English is required (at least B2 level according to the [CEFR](https://go.fzj.de/languagerequirements)), ideally supported by a certificate confirming the language level

Experience with photosynthesis measurements, root phenotyping, plant imaging, MRI, PET, field phenotyping, remote sensing, image analysis, machine learning or plant modelling is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

## Our Benefits for You

- **Team & Environment:** You will work in a motivated team with an international and interdisciplinary focus – at one of the largest research institutions in Europe
- **Research & Infrastructure:** You will have access to excellent scientific and technical facilities for your work
- **Networking & Exchange:** You will participate in (international) conferences and project meetings and actively build your scientific network
- **Supervision & Support:** We will accompany your doctoral studies with continuous, expert guidance from your academic supervisor
- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your professional and personal life. You also have the option of flexible working (in terms of location), which is generally possible after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
- **Annual Leave:** You get 30 days of annual leave
- **Knowledge & Development:** Your professional development is important to us – we support you specifically and individually e.g., through training and networking opportunities specifically for doctoral candidates [(JuDocS)](https://go.fzj.de/JuDocs)
- **Successful start:** It is important to us that you quickly settle into the team and are given structured training for your tasks. We also support you from the very beginning and make your start easier with our [Welcome Days and Welcome Guide](https://www.fz-juelich.de/en/gp/welcome-to-forschungszentrum-julich)

title: Doctoral researcher (f_m_x) – Terrestrial and Cryo-Hydrological Gravimetry
descriptionHtml:
The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: “Taking the pulse of the Earth to safeguard a habitable planet.”

For section [1.2 Global Geomonitoring and Gravity](https://www.gfz.de/en/section/global-geomonitoring-and-gravity-field/overview) Field (department["Geodesy"](https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geodesy)), we are looking for a:

Doctoral researcher (f_m_x) – Terrestrial and Cryo-Hydrological Gravimetry

Reference Number 11591

The GFZ department "Geodesy" has five independent sections that together advance the goals of the Helmholtz research programme "Changing Earth - Sustaining our Future" and provide important GFZ services and infrastructure within the Modular Earth Science Infrastructure (MESI). With this call, we are looking for a PhD student for section 1.2 "Global Geomonitoring and Gravity Field". This section focuses on developing and operating infrastructure for gravity field observations from global to local scales, with applications spanning geodynamic and climatic processes, water budgets, and hazard monitoring.

The PhD position is part of the [ERC Synergy Grant Project "SnowShifts - Current and future shifts of snow regimes in extreme environments"](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858)seeking to significantly enhance our comprehension of snow volume and mass, their non-linear dynamics and properties and, specifically, snow regime shifts within the Earth and climate systems. The PhD student will be embedded in a highly vibrant team of PhD students and Postdocs from the project partners at the University of Oslo, BOKU Vienna, EPFL Lausanne and CNRS CESBIO Toulouse. The PhD student will be responsible for high-resolution snow mass quantification at local scales based on superconducting gravimetry at focus sites in high mountains (Zugspitze, Lhasa) and polar regions (Ny-Ålesund, Syowa, Jang Bogo). The joint analysis of terrestrial and satellite gravimetry will be carried out in a team with a Postdoc who will be responsible for the quantification of regional snow mass variations using spatio-temporally downscaled data from the GRACE/GRACE-FO and the upcoming GRACE-C satellite missions.

Your responsibilities:

- Process and analyse time series of temporal gravity variations from superconducting gravimeters
- Implement a state-of-the-art toolbox for processing superconducting gravimeter time series
- Quantify snow water equivalent variations based on superconducting gravimeter time series
- Work on the gravimetric subproject in SnowShifts with personal responsibility and highly interdisciplinary cooperation with the external project partners from cryospheric sciences and remote sensing as well as colleagues from GFZ
- Write scientific publications and present results at project meetings and conferences
- Prepare a PhD thesis

About You:

Essential Qualifications:

- Completed academic university degree (master's, diploma or equivalent) in Geodesy, Geophysics, Geosciences, Physics or a similar subject
- Knowledge of temporal gravity field variations and their observation from space and from the Earth's surface
- Experience in time series analyses and statistics
- Good programming skills, e.g. in Python, MATLAB, FORTRAN
- Ability and willingness for fieldwork in high-alpine and polar regions
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Very good command of English

Desirable Qualifications:

- Knowledge of the German language

Start date: 1st February 2027
Fixed-term: 3 Jahre
Salary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.
Working hours: Teilzeit 75% (derzeit 29,25 h/Woche)
Place of work: Potsdam

What we offer:

- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Public service benefits
- Extensive training opportunities
- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career Centre
- Flexible working hours and conditions
- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work
- Institute day-care centre on site
- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam
- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle bus

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 4th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.

Required documents: CV, letter of motivation, grades/certificates

Desirable documents: references if available

The GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.

“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. The job is a Senior Container Administrator role.  The environment to be managed is an air-gapped on-prem solution.  The expectation is that the candidate will also perform Unix/Linux administration activities.

The job is located in the north of Munich (on site as no remote working is possible).

**Tasks:**

- Deploy, configure, and maintain Rancher-based container platform in an air-gapped environment. 
- Manage Kubernetes clusters, nodes, and workloads within the Rancher ecosystem. 
- Administer Unix-based operating systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting. 
- Implement security hardening practices for containerized environments and Unix servers. 
- Automate system and container operations using scripting languages such as Ansible. 
- Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery for containerized workloads. 
- Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for both Rancher and Unix infrastructure. 
- Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. 
- Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation. 
- Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration. 

**Requirements/Knowledge/Experience:**

- Proven experience in Rancher container orchestration and Kubernetes administration. 
- Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar). 
- Knowledge of air-gapped deployments and best practices for secure environments. 
- Proficiency in infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools. 
- Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki. 
- Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills for both containers and Unix systems. 
- Familiarity with container security tools and practices. 
- Experience working with containerized databases and persistent storage solutions.
- Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, etc.). 
- Certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.
- Understanding of SIEM tools and security event monitoring focused on containers is an advantage. 
- Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.
- Strong background in IT (working in IT).
- IT related Bachelor or Master’s degree is a plus.
- Any knowledge of ITIL would be useful.

descriptionHtml:

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

     * Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
     * Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität

     * Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical

title: Senior Embedded Control Systems Engineer (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
# Who we are
The Product Design Center of TK Elevator Innovation and Operations GmbH is responsible for the development of product features, harmonized global product platforms, as well as the conception and development of complete escalator and moving walk system types. Working in international teams alongside colleagues from our development centers in China and Spain, we create innovations for the efficient escalators and moving walks of the future.
The international nature of our work is reflected in the close collaboration and regular exchange with experts from various engineering disciplines worldwide. In addition, our proximity to manufacturing at our Hamburg site ensures close integration between development and production, enabling us to support development projects directly on the production line and through their market launch.

# What we expect
- Specification, programming, and testing of embedded software in C/C++ for ARM-based control systems.
- Development and Design of electrical systems for escalators, including drives, safety, lighting, and sensors.
- Creation and maintenance of complex circuit diagrams, assembly layouts and project templates including programming of PLC-based simulators and test benches.
- Certification of functional safety and cybersecurity systems according to the standards IEC 61508 and IEC 62443.
- Cross-functional collaboration with Product Management, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Quality and Service.
- Definition and execution of test plans for validating designs according to acceptance criteria.
- Technical support during commissioning, testing, and failure analysis at national and international customer sites.

# Who we are looking for
- Degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable discipline (university or university of applied sciences).
- Strong microcontroller programming skills in C/C++, ideally complemented by PLC programming experience (e.g., Siemens S7, TwinCAT).
- 5–10 years of professional experience in Research und Development, preferably in electronics or electrical engineering.
- Confident use of IAR Embedded Workbench and Atlassian tools. Experience with Parasoft, TwinCAT, EPLAN, or Altium is considered an advantage.
- Knowledge of standards IEC 61508 and IEC 62443, as well as experience in the elevator/escalator sector, is an advantage.
- Functional Safety Engineer (FSE) certification is an advantage.
- Experience in electrical testing (electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility, etc.) is an advantage.
- Project management knowledge is an advantage.
- Team-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and a structured way of working.
- High level of initiative and enthusiasm for technical innovation.
- Business fluent in English and German.
- Willingness to travel internationally.

# What we offer
- Health and Safety – Highest standards and a wide range of health promotion and healthcare activities
- Flexibility – We support, for example, through flexible yet regulated working hours and remote working options
- Compensation und pension – Fair working conditions, competitive compensation, following “Collective Agreements” and support with pension schemes
- Collaboration und diversity – Collegiality is of huge importance – we treat everyone with respect and appreciation
- Development – Individual support to help you get started in your new job as well as training and education programs to help you develop professionally and personally
- Creative leeway – We offer an environment in which you can try out new solutions in a no-blame-culture

- Attractive Location: Subsidized cafeteria, a convenient location in Hamburg with parking, and excellent access to public transportation.

title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
**Key Account Manager, Germany, Austria & Switzerland (GAS)**

**Location:** South Germany (Remote)
**Reporting to:** Sales Director, Western Europe

**Drive the Future of Mobility**

At Gilbarco Veeder-Root, we're helping shape the future of fuel retailing, mobility, and payment technologies. For more than 150 years, our solutions have kept the world moving, and today we're at the forefront of innovation as smart cities, vehicle electrification, digital payments, and connected technologies transform the industry.

As a global technology leader, we provide one of the industry's broadest portfolios of integrated solutions, trusted by customers around the world. Now, we're looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager to lead growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

If you're passionate about building strategic customer relationships, developing new business opportunities, and delivering complex technology solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Opportunity**

As Key Account Manager for the GAS region, you will play a critical role in driving sales growth and strengthening Gilbarco Veeder-Root's presence across key strategic accounts. Acting as the primary customer contact within the region, you'll develop long-term partnerships, identify new opportunities, and lead the execution of our go-to-market strategy.

Working closely with colleagues across sales, business development, marketing, and operations, you'll help shape growth plans, influence customer strategies, and bring innovative solutions to market.

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Build, develop, and maintain trusted relationships with key customers across the GAS region
- Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring exceptional customer engagement and support
- Develop and execute account growth plans to achieve ambitious sales objectives
- Identify and convert new business opportunities within existing and prospective customer accounts
- Create and manage a strong sales pipeline while driving sustainable revenue growth
- Lead customer negotiations and prepare compelling commercial proposals, quotations, and tenders
- Promote Gilbarco Veeder-Root's portfolio of products, services, and technology solutions
- Support the implementation of regional go-to-market and business growth strategies
- Collaborate with sales, business development, marketing, and channel teams to maximise opportunities
- Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings
- Drive market awareness initiatives and support the launch of new solutions and services

**WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications)**

**What You'll Bring**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

- Proven success in Key Account Management and B2B sales environments
- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing complex customer relationships
- Experience developing strategic account plans and delivering measurable business growth
- Understanding of solution-based selling, project sales, and partner-led business models
- Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills
- Strong presentation and stakeholder management capabilities
- Experience working with CRM systems and sales analytics tools
- Project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives effectively
- Fluent German and English language skills

**Advantageous Experience**

- Knowledge of fuel retail, forecourt technologies, or mobility markets
- Understanding of digital payments, retail technology, or connected services
- Experience working within an international manufacturing or technology business
- Success working in cross-functional and culturally diverse environments
- Experience managing customers across multiple European markets

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline
- Additional qualifications in project management, business development, marketing, or sales are beneficial

**WHO IS GILBARCO VEEDER-ROOT**

Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems.

WHO IS VONTIER

**WHO IS VONTIER**
Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.

With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at [www.vontier.com](https://www.vontier.com/)

**At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.**

Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.

Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.

**Together, let’s power the way the world moves!**

Job Description

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.


BioProduction Group (BPG) at Thermo Fisher Scientific is dedicated to providing innovative solutions for bioproduction and bioprocessing. Our team focuses on developing and delivering high-quality products and services that support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, vaccines, and cell and gene therapies.


Location
Germany or Austria, ideally based in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, within convenient reach of a major airport or transportation hub.

Territory covers Germany and, depending on home location, Austria. Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory.


Discover Impactful Work
As a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows.


You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. Acting as a trusted advisor and problem solver, you will help customers achieve compliant, efficient, and high-performing processes using Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.


A Day in the Life:
Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows.


Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements.


What to expect:


- Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution.
- Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows.
- Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.
- Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence.
- Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization.
- Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes.
- Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership.


Keys to Success:
Education


- BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience.


Experience


- 5+ years of hands-on bioprocessing experience, ideally within Process Development, with strong expertise in downstream processing.
- Demonstrated experience with downstream purification technologies, including chromatography, UF/DF, centrifugation, and related unit operations.
- Proven track record of technical engagement, process troubleshooting, and problem solving within Process Development and/or biomanufacturing environments.
- Experience supporting process scale-up, technology transfer, and process optimization from development through pilot and manufacturing scale.
- Hands-on experience with commonly used chromatography systems/skids at laboratory, pilot, and manufacturing scale, including the ability to operate systems and interpret data using commonly used chromatography software.
- Practical experience with column packing at small, pilot, and/or manufacturing scale.


Knowledge, Skills, Abilities


- Deep understanding of bioprocessing and downstream purification workflows, with the ability to translate scientific and engineering principles into practical customer solutions.
- Strong capability in process design, optimization, troubleshooting, and workflow consulting, using data-driven approaches to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT), Design of Experiments (DoE), and Quality by Design (QbD) principles, including relevant ICH Q8, Q9, and Q10 concepts.
- Knowledge of analytical methods used to support purification process development, including HPLC, ELISA, SDS-PAGE, and spectroscopy, with the ability to interpret and communicate analytical data.
- Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel and JMP; experience with scripting or additional analytical tools is an advantage.
- Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientists, engineers, operators, and senior technical stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving and influencing skills, with demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional and matrixed environments.
- Experience using Salesforce.com (SFDC CRM) for customer engagement, opportunity, and activity tracking.
- Fluent in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
- Based in Germany or Austria, ideally in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, with convenient access to a major airport or transportation hub to support frequent travel across the assigned territory.
- Willing and able to travel up to 50%, primarily across Germany and, depending on home location, Austria.
- Valid driver’s license and passport, with the ability to travel as required within the territory.


Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Clinical Research Associate I (CRA I) / Klinischer Monitor – Full-Time or Part-Time Available (m/w/d)

Job available in 13 locations: Ulm, Bremen, Munich, Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Stuttgart, Bonn, Remote, Leipzig, Aachen, Dresden, Düsseldorf

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)


Environmental Conditions
Office


Job Description


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.


Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.


The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).


## The CRA:


- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.

- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..

- Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability.

- Ensures audit readiness.

- Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.

- Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.

- Travel up to 50-75%


## A day in the Life:


- Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.

- Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.

- Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.

- Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.

- Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.

- May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.

- Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.

- Participates in the investigator payment process.

- Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.

- Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

- Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.

- Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).

- Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

- Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.

- Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

- Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

- Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).

- Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.

- Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.

- Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

- Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.


## Education and Experience


- Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

- Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role

- Valid driver's license

- Full Right to work in Germany

- Fluency in English and German language to at least C1 level (note that the interview will be held in German).


## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities


- Effective clinical monitoring skills

- Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology

- Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents

- Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical attitude, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and decision-making

- Ability to handles Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes

- Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel

- Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues

- Effective social skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Effective organizational and time management skills

- Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios

- Ability to work in a team or independently as required

- Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software

- Good presentation skills

At Evernow, everything revolves around creative brand development and holistic communication. In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.

As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.

- Take full ownership of revenue growth, pipeline development and commercial performance within the assigned territory

- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements
- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions
- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing
- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions

##
